lines.en: label halloweenfour2:
scene halloweenfourmingle1
: Is it just me or does Ayane’s party room seem a little more green than normal this year?
lines.zh: : 是我多心了吗，还是 Ayane 的派对房间今年比往年更绿了点？

lines.en: : And is it just {i}me{/i} or has her taste in Halloween decor gotten even stranger?
lines.zh: : 还是{i}我{/i}多心了，她在万圣节装饰上的品味是不是变得更怪了？

lines.en: : I will have you know that I had nothing to do with the decor and that everything here has been personally chosen by Geoffrey and his son.
lines.zh: : 我可要告诉你们，这些装饰跟我一点关系都没有，这里的一切都是 Geoffrey 和他儿子亲自挑的。

lines.en: : Their existence continues to become stranger and stranger each time you bring them up.
lines.zh: : 你每提一次，他们的存在就变得更离奇一分。

lines.en: We make it to Ayane’s mansion before the sun sets and, as always, it is fully stocked with a variety of food and adolescent bodies that I will one day put my penis inside (assuming I have not already done that).
lines.zh: 我们在日落前赶到了 Ayane 的宅邸。和往常一样，这里堆满了各色食物，以及各色青春期少女的躯体——总有一天我会把阴茎放进她们体内（假设我还没放进去过）。

lines.en: Also, just to clarify as that sentence could be easily misread or misheard as something else, I have no intention of putting my penis inside any food.
lines.zh: 另外澄清一下，因为上面那句话很容易被误读或听错成别的意思：我完全没打算把阴茎放进任何食物里。

lines.en: At least not while I’m fully conscious. But at the rate things seem to be going today, who even knows?
lines.zh: 至少在我完全清醒的时候不会。不过看今天这走势，谁说得准呢？

lines.en: I’m fine now, though. I’m as peachy as a peach. As Jolly as a rancher. And as excited as a small dog being hand-fed chocolate moments before discovering his body can not process it only to subsequently die.
lines.zh: 不过我现在没事。我像桃子一样水灵。像牧场主一样快活。还像一只被人手喂着巧克力的小狗那样兴奋——就在它发现自己无法代谢巧克力、随即死掉之前的那一刻。

lines.en: Is this me saying I’m going to die today? Of course not. There’s no way that could be true. Or at least I hope it isn’t true as there are still so many foods here I’ve yet to put my penis inside. Wait. No. I meant girls.
lines.zh: 我这是在说自己今天要死了吗？当然不是。那不可能是真的。至少我希望不是，因为这里还有那么多食物我没把阴茎放进去过。等等。不对。我是说女生。

lines.en: I have to stop thinking of one thing while looking at another thing. I need to act like my head isn’t falling off when I know it is. I should stand still so my brain stops rattling. I should speak and break the silence.
lines.zh: 我得停止看着一样东西却想着另一样。我得装作自己的脑袋没掉下来，尽管我知道它掉了。我该站着别动，好让脑子不再晃荡。我该说点什么，打破沉默。

lines.en: : It’s boner time.
lines.zh: : 勃起时间到了。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle2
I did it. I said something normal. The day is saved.
lines.zh: 我做到了。我说了一句正常的话。今天得救了。

lines.en: : Uhhhhh, what?
lines.zh: : 呃……什么？

lines.en: : I don’t think it’s boner time right now, Sensei. Did you mean to say “party time” maybe?
lines.zh: : 我觉得现在不是勃起时间吧，Sensei。你是不是想说「派对时间」？

lines.en: : I feel like that would be even more out of character.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那样反而更不像他会说的话。

lines.en: : Can you maybe wait until the party is at least halfway over to start sexually harassing everyone? I haven’t built up my daily immunity to nonsense just yet.
lines.zh: : 你能不能至少等派对过半再开始对所有人性骚扰？我今天的胡说八道免疫力还没建立起来呢。

lines.en: I made a mistake. Everything I do is a mistake. Somebody feed me chocolate before I devour a cat.
lines.zh: 我犯了个错。我做的一切都是错。谁来喂我点巧克力吧，免得我生吞一只猫。

lines.en: : Do you want to go lie down? I can have Geoffrey go lay out a futon for you and you can rejoin us when you’re not as...{i}tired.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你要去躺一会儿吗？我可以让 Geoffrey 给你铺一床被褥，等你没那么……{i}累{/i}了再回来找我们。

lines.en: : I think that’s a good idea. I’ll go with him.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这是个好主意。我陪他去。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle3
: Yeah, because {i}that{/i} is safer than letting him flop around like a fish out of water.
lines.zh: : 是啊，因为{i}那样{/i}总比让他像离了水的鱼一样扑腾要安全。

lines.en: : Fish can’t survive outside of water and Sensei can’t survive without me. You guys go have fun. I’ll go rub his head and sing him lullabies.
lines.zh: : 鱼离了水活不了，Sensei 离了我活不了。你们去玩吧。我去摸摸他的头，给他唱摇篮曲。

lines.en: : I’m fine. I can assimilate. I think I’m just a little behind on sleep. But going around and saying hello to everyone will wake me up. It’s the beginning of a special event, so I have to do that.
lines.zh: : 我没事。我能适应。我想我只是有点缺觉。但挨个跟大家打招呼会让我清醒过来。这是特别活动的开场，我必须这么做。

lines.en: : Once I do that, things will fall back into place and everything will be normal again. I’ve figured out the process.
lines.zh: : 只要我这么做了，一切就会归位，一切都会恢复正常。我已经摸清流程了。

lines.en: : Well {i}somebody{/i} should do something before-
lines.zh: : 嗯，{i}谁{/i}该在他-

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle4
: ...and there he goes.
lines.zh: : ……他走了。

lines.en: : He hasn’t been this way all morning, has he?
lines.zh: : 他一早上都这样吗？

lines.en: : He didn’t even wake up until past noon today. And when he finally {i}did,{/i} he thought I was you.
lines.zh: : 他今天过了中午才醒。等他终于{i}醒{/i}了，还以为我是你。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle5
: Is {i}that{/i} what you were alluding to with that thing about...pranks you said earlier? Did he say something to you?
lines.zh: : 你之前说的……恶作剧，指的就是{i}这个{/i}吗？他跟你说什么了？

lines.en: : He said a few things to me. But I’m a good niece now and I’m not going to pry into anyone’s business anymore. I’ll just silently doubt you instead.
lines.zh: : 他跟我说了几句。但我现在是个乖侄女了，不会再打听别人的事。我就在心里默默怀疑你好了。

lines.en: : Ami, whatever he said, I’m sure it was just-
lines.zh: : Ami，不管他说了什么，我相信那只是-

lines.en: : You look really cute in that costume, Maya.
lines.zh: : 你穿那身衣服真好看，Maya。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle6
: ...thanks.
: I’m gonna head over to the buffet. Should I grab a plate for you as well? Or would you rather just pick the scraps off of mine?
lines.zh: : 我要去自助餐那边了。要我顺便给你拿个盘子吗？还是你更想直接从我盘子里捡剩的？

lines.en: : I...can get my own plate, Ami...
lines.zh: : 我……可以自己拿盘子，Ami……

lines.en: : Really? That’s news to me.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？这我倒是头回听说。

lines.en: : Weren’t you two supposed to be on better terms now? Whatever happened to that?
lines.zh: : 你们俩不是应该和好了吗？那事后来怎么样了？

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle7
: {i}Hah...{/i}fate, maybe?
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}也许是命运吧？

lines.en: : Let’s just forget all of this ever happened and try to enjoy ourselves for a few hours.
lines.zh: : 我们就当这一切都没发生过，开开心心玩几个小时吧。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle8
{i}Welcome to the first ever “special” update for Lessons in Love, a game about being happy!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}欢迎来到《Lessons in Love》史上第一个「特别」更新——一款关于变得幸福的游戏！{/i}

lines.en: {i}If you’re not already familiar with how to play, here is a quick tutorial.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}如果你还不熟悉玩法，这里有一份快速教程。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Step one: Pay close attention to everything everyone says — because you never know when someone might be foreshadowing something!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}第一步：密切留意每个人说的每一句话——因为你永远不知道谁会在什么时候埋下伏笔！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Step two: Ignore step one and come up with your own abstract idea for the story {b}you{/b} want to read. Then, disregard any information that does not support it as unreliable narration.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}第二步：无视第一步，为{b}你{/b}想读的故事构想出一个属于自己的抽象点子。然后，把所有不支持它的信息都当作不可靠叙述丢掉。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Step three: Grind affection and lust points to use as currency for future sex scenes. Just not too many of them because you might eventually be punished for it!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}第三步：刷好感度和情欲点数，当作日后 H 场景的货币。但别刷太多，因为你最终可能因此受到惩罚！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Step four: Accept that you might eventually be punished for things you didn’t even realize you were doing incorrectly because life is unfair and mean and everything should be about you all the time.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}第四步：接受这一点——你可能最终会因为一些你根本没意识到自己做错了的事而受罚，因为生活既不公平又刻薄，而且一切都该永远围着你转。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Step five: Everything is always about you. All the time. Always.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}第五步：一切都永远是关于你的。无时无刻。永远如此。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Step six: Reinforce that belief! As hard as you can! Everything revolves around you! You are the best!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}第六步：加固这个信念！用尽全力！一切都围着你转！你是最棒的！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Step seven: Forget step two, then remember step one. Grind your ideas into dust and sprinkle them throughout the three halves of the city so that there are little bits and pieces of them in everything.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}第七步：忘掉第二步，再想起第一步。把你的想法碾成粉尘，撒遍这座城市的三半，好让万事万物里都掺着它们的碎屑。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Step eight: See the world through someone else’s eyes. Taste the dust of your thoughts for the very first time with the tongues of other unknowing creatures.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}第八步：用别人的眼睛看世界。借其他无知生物的舌头，第一次尝到自己思想的粉尘。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Step nine: Forget steps five and six. Remember step four. Then contemplate giving up altogether because none of this makes any sense. Proceed to the tenth step.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}第九步：忘掉第五步和第六步。记起第四步。然后考虑干脆放弃，因为这一切毫无意义。接着进入第十步。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Step ten: Ignore steps one, three, four, five, six, seven, and eight. Reinforce step two. But remember what you gave away in exchange for that.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}第十步：无视第一步、第三步、第四步、第五步、第六步、第七步和第八步。加固第二步。但要记住你为此付出了什么。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Remember how much information you ground up into dust and sprinkled all across the city (See step seven). Think about what it could have meant if steps two and five and six never existed.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}记住，你碾成粉尘、撒遍全城的信息有多少（参见第七步）。想想如果第二步、第五步和第六步从未存在过，一切会意味着什么。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And there you go! That’s how you play Lessons in Love! Easy, right?{i}
lines.zh: {i}就是这样！这就是《Lessons in Love》的玩法！很简单，对吧？{/i}

lines.en: {i}It’s only as complicated as you make it.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}它只会有你自己弄得那么复杂。{/i}

lines.en: {i}So why do you always make it so complicated?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那你为什么总把它弄得这么复杂？{/i}

lines.en: : Party time.
lines.zh: : 派对时间到了。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle9
: ...and that’s why I think sex robots will one day be a regular household item.
lines.zh: : ……所以我觉得性爱机器人总有一天会成为家家户户的普通用品。

lines.en: : I’ve never been more excited for the future than I am right now.
lines.zh: : 我从未像此刻这样对未来充满期待。

lines.en: : Hey. Congratulations on being the first two girls I approached at this party.
lines.zh: : 嘿。恭喜你们成为我在这个派对上主动搭话的前两个人。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle10
: Oh, Sensei! You just missed my story about sex robots.
lines.zh: : 哦，Sensei！你刚好错过了我的性爱机器人故事。

lines.en: : Good evening, Father. Peace be with you.
lines.zh: : 晚上好，神父。愿平安与你同在。

lines.en: : And also with you. Why are you a nun?
lines.zh: : 也与你同在。你怎么扮成了修女？

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle11
: Obviously because it is my sworn duty to share the truth and the good word with everyone. And there is no outfit more fitting for such a duty than that of a sister.
lines.zh: : 显然，因为向所有人传播真理与福音是我宣誓的职责。而没有哪种装扮比修女的更适合承担这份职责了。

lines.en: : Also, there is something particularly alluring about wearing such an outfit without undergarments. Which, I will have both of you know, is precisely the state I am in right now.
lines.zh: : 另外，不穿内衣就套上这样一身，有种格外诱人的意味。而我要请二位知悉，我此刻正是这种状态。

lines.en: : Could be worse. You could be wearing mine again.
lines.zh: : 本来还可能更糟。你可能会又穿回我那身。

lines.en: : And what are {i}you{/i} supposed to be, Rin?
lines.zh: : 那你扮的{i}又{/i}是什么，Rin？

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle12
: Zone-tan! Who, like Nodoka right now, probably doesn’t wear underwear either. But I will have you know that I am. Which you probably didn’t {i}need{/i} to know, but still. Hi.
lines.zh: : Zone-tan！她和现在的 Nodoka 一样，大概也不穿内衣。不过我要告诉你，我穿了。虽然你大概{i}不需要{/i}知道这个。总之，嗨。

lines.en: : I still don’t have any idea what that is.
lines.zh: : 我还是完全不知道那是什么。

lines.en: : Good. Please preserve whatever image you have of me and don’t look her up.
lines.zh: : 很好。请保持你心里对我的印象，别去搜她。

lines.en: : Will do. Why is it just you two over here, though? What’s going on with Otoha and Futaba?
lines.zh: : 遵命。不过怎么只有你们俩在这儿？Otoha 和 Futaba 怎么了？

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle13
: Otoha couldn’t make it and...I could have sworn Futaba told you about the animosity between her and Nodoka right now.
lines.zh: : Otoha 来不了，还有……我明明记得 Futaba 跟你说过她和 Nodoka 现在关系很僵。

lines.en: : Oh, right. I think I was supposed to talk to you about that, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我好像是应该跟你谈谈这事，Nodoka。

lines.en: : Have you come to discipline me for being a {i}bad girl,{/i} Akira?
lines.zh: : 你是来管教我这个{i}坏女孩{/i}的吗，Akira？

lines.en: : Please don’t call me that when there are others here who don’t know that name yet. And no, I’m not going to discipline you. I’m just supposed to tell you to stop publishing your book.
lines.zh: : 这里还有人不知道这个名字，别这么叫我。还有，不，我不是来管教你的。我只是来告诉你，别再出版你那本书了。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle14
: And why would I do that?
lines.zh: : 我为什么要那么做？

lines.en: : Because it’s going to ruin your relationship with the one person you seem to have actual feelings for.
lines.zh: : 因为那会毁掉你和你唯一真正有感情的人之间的关系。

lines.en: : I’m assuming that you’re referring to Futaba right now. Which calls into question exactly what you think my feelings for {i}you{/i} are.
lines.zh: : 我猜你现在指的是 Futaba。这就让人不禁要问，你觉得我对{i}你{/i}又是什么感情。

lines.en: : Do you not believe you are important to me, Akira? Because I thought I made it quite {i}audibly{/i} apparent that you are.
lines.zh: : 你不相信自己对我很重要吗，Akira？我以为我已经用{i}听得见的方式{/i}表达得很明白了。

lines.en: : You have no intention of stopping, do you?
lines.zh: : 你根本没打算停手，是吧？

lines.en: : I do not. I’m far too fond of the way it feels to {i}insert{/i} myself into the shoes of the many other girls you’ve violated. But I believe Futaba will come around to see things my way eventually.
lines.zh: : 是的。我实在太喜欢{i}把自己{/i}代入那些被你玷污过的女孩的处境里了。不过我相信 Futaba 迟早会想通的。

lines.en: : There is no malice in what I do. If the costume is not a sign enough- I seek to save, not to destroy.
lines.zh: : 我所做的一切并无恶意。如果这身装扮还不足以说明——我寻求的是拯救，而非毁灭。

lines.en: : Nodoka, I don’t really think you’re understanding exactly how betrayed Futaba feels by you. I doubt this is a thing that even {i}she{/i} is going to just “come around” to.
lines.zh: : Nodoka，我觉得你根本不明白 Futaba 有多觉得被你背叛。我很怀疑这件事就连{i}她{/i}也不太可能就这么「想通」。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle15
: But you’ve already come around, haven’t you? Otherwise, you’d be with her instead of me.
lines.zh: : 但你自己已经想通了，不是吗？否则你现在该陪着她，而不是陪着我。

lines.en: : She’s pissed off at me too, you know. Plus, there’s not really anything I feel like I have to {i}hide{/i} since {i}I{/i} didn’t lose my virginity to my high school teacher.
lines.zh: : 她也在生我的气，你知道的。再说，我也没什么好{i}藏{/i}的，毕竟{i}我{/i}的初夜不是交给高中老师的。

lines.en: : From what I’ve seen in reader feedback, most people wish you would have.
lines.zh: : 就我在读者反馈里看到的，大部分人都希望你交给了他。

lines.en: : Can you at least apologize to her or something? It feels weird watching her avoid you when she’s been your number one fan for basically forever.
lines.zh: : 你至少能跟她道个歉什么的吧？看着她躲你，我觉得挺别扭的，毕竟她基本上一直都是你的头号粉丝。

lines.en: : I will consider it. This outfit does put me in a charitable mood, after all.
lines.zh: : 我会考虑的。毕竟这身衣服确实让我心情慷慨。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle16
: A {i}very{/i} charitable mood, might I add. Perhaps there is something I could assist {i}you{/i} with, Akira?
lines.zh: : 容我补充，是{i}非常{/i}慷慨。也许有什么我能帮{i}你{/i}的，Akira？

lines.en: : A confession, perhaps? The “word of the lord?” A discreet handjob under the table as we gaze into one another’s eyes?
lines.zh: : 一场告解，如何？「主的话语」？还是我们四目相对时，在桌子底下悄悄地打一次飞机？

lines.en: : Nodoka, come on. I know these tablecloths are long, but there’s no way you’d be able to pull that off without {i}somebody{/i} catching on.
lines.zh: : Nodoka，别闹了。我知道这些桌布很长，但你不可能做到不被{i}任何人{/i}发现。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle17
: So long as that somebody is you, I see no issue. You could even assist me if you’d like. There’s more than enough of him to go around, Rin. Otoha never has to know.
lines.zh: : 只要那个人是你，我就觉得没什么问题。你愿意的话甚至可以帮我一把。他身上的分量够大家分的，Rin。Otoha 永远不必知道。

lines.en: : I...think I’m gonna pass. So, sorry to all of your readers, but they’re going to have to wait a little longer.
lines.zh: : 我……想我还是算了。那么，替我向你的读者们说声抱歉，他们得再等一阵子了。

lines.en: : How unfortunate. Such a chapter would be sure to stir something inside of Futaba and I’m interested in seeing how that would change the dynamic between the two of you.
lines.zh: : 真遗憾。那样的一章必定会在 Futaba 心里掀起些什么，我倒是很有兴趣看看那会如何改变你们两人之间的关系。

lines.en: : Yeah...I’m not.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我可没兴趣。

lines.en: : Well, I guess I’ll be the one to go hang out with her since neither of you two are going to do it.
lines.zh: : 好吧，既然你们俩都不去，那看来只能我去陪她了。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle18
: I want to! She just-
lines.zh: : 我想去的！她只是-

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle19
: Hey. What are you doing all alone? Even if you’re at odds with Rin and Nodoka, there are still a couple tables full of girls who would be happy to have you.
lines.zh: : 嘿。你怎么一个人待着？就算你和 Rin、Nodoka 闹别扭，那边还有好几桌女生会很乐意让你加入。

lines.en: : You weren’t just talking about me to them, were you?
lines.zh: : 你刚才不是在跟她们聊我吧？

lines.en: : Was I...not supposed to do that?
lines.zh: : 我……不该这么做吗？

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle20
: Hah...no. You weren’t. They know what they did wrong and I don’t need your assistance when it comes to making them feel bad about it.
lines.zh: : 哈……对，你不该。她们知道自己做错了什么，而让她们为此愧疚这件事，我不需要你帮忙。

lines.en: : I guess you were just trying to help, though...
lines.zh: : 不过我想你只是想帮忙……

lines.en: : I just don’t really like seeing you alone like this. You’re pretty much always talking to {i}someone{/i} at these parties.
lines.zh: : 我只是不太喜欢看你这样一个人待着。在这种派对上，你几乎总在跟{i}什么人{/i}说话。

lines.en: : I just wanted to be alone for a little while, that’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是想一个人待一会儿，就这样。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle21
: Honestly, I wasn’t even sure if I was going to come or not. I’m not the biggest fan of...the way I look this year, so...
lines.zh: : 说实话，我本来都不确定要不要来。我不太喜欢……自己今年的样子，所以……

lines.en: : Why not? You look great.
lines.zh: : 为什么？你看起来很棒啊。

lines.en: : The costume itself is beautiful. Molly did a wonderful job- especially on such short notice. I don’t typically show off as much of my thighs as this, so...
lines.zh: : 衣服本身很漂亮。Molly 做得非常好——尤其是在这么赶的时间里。我平时不会露这么多大腿，所以……

lines.en: : Well, if it’s any consolation, I’ve seen {i}much{/i} more of your thighs than that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果这能让你好受点的话，你的大腿我看过的可比这{i}多得多{/i}。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle20
: You’re a special case. You’ve seen more of me than anyone. There’s even a book about it now.
lines.zh: : 你是个特例。你看到的我比任何人都多。现在甚至还有一本书写了这些。

lines.en: : I take it that means you still feel the same way about it that you did in my office?
lines.zh: : 这么说，你对这件事的感受还和在我办公室时一样？

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle21
: Honestly...I barely remember how that conversation went. But I’m definitely not okay with it if that’s what you’re asking.
lines.zh: : 说实话……我几乎不记得那次对话是怎么说的了。但如果你问的是这个，我绝对没有释怀。

lines.en: : I’m just glad that no one else in our class really {i}reads.{/i} That’s...pretty much the only thing keeping me going at the moment.
lines.zh: : 我只是庆幸我们班上没有别人真的{i}读书{/i}。这……几乎是现在唯一支撑着我的东西。

lines.en: : But now there’s this...added layer of pressure any time anyone looks at me.
lines.zh: : 但现在，只要有人看我，就会多出一层……压力。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle22
: That’s always been there, of course. You understand by now the way I see myself. It’s just...worse knowing that someone could be seeing {i}through{/i} that.
lines.zh: : 当然，这种感觉一直都在。你现在应该明白我是怎么看自己的了。只是……一想到有人可能正{i}看穿{/i}这一切，就更难受了。

lines.en: : I...I get that anyone who doesn’t know our story specifically isn’t going to assume I’m just the...real-life version of a character from a book-
lines.zh: : 我……我明白，不了解我们故事的人，不会把我当成……书里某个角色的现实版本-

lines.en: : But just because it’s an irrational way of thinking doesn’t mean I have any idea how to make it stop.
lines.zh: : 但就算这种想法不理性，也不代表我知道该怎么让它停下来。

lines.en: : If controlling my brain were that simple, I would have started doing it years ago.
lines.zh: : 要是控制自己的脑子有那么简单，我几年前就开始做了。

lines.en: : Everything’s going to be okay, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 一切都会好起来的，Futaba。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle20
: I hope you’re right, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我希望你是对的，Sensei。

lines.en: : But if it’s not a problem, I think I’d like to go back to being a loner for a little while. I’m not really in a talking mood right now.
lines.zh: : 不过如果不麻烦的话，我想再一个人待一会儿。我现在真的不太想说话。

lines.en: : Fine by me. But, should you find yourself wanting to talk to someone, Rin {i}does{/i} seem at least mildly remorseful.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。不过，要是你哪天想找人聊聊，Rin {i}确实{/i}看起来至少有点愧疚。

lines.en: : Nodoka, on the other hand-
lines.zh: : 至于 Nodoka，另一方面-

lines.en: : Is likely incapable of even feeling such a thing. I know.
lines.zh: : 大概根本不可能有这种感觉。我知道。

lines.en: : As long as you know. I’ll see you around, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 你知道就好。回头见，Futaba。

lines.en: : I hope you won’t. That would mean I’m actually standing out.
lines.zh: : 我希望不会。那说明我真的很显眼。

lines.en: scene black
scene halloweenfourmingle23
: Heeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeey...
: Am I pretty?
lines.zh: : 我漂亮吗？

lines.en: : No, but Karin sure is.
lines.zh: : 不漂亮，但 Karin 漂亮。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle24
: Ah! How {i}dare{/i} you! Do you have any idea what fate will befall you now?!
lines.zh: : 啊！你{i}竟敢{/i}！你知道接下来你会落得什么下场吗？！

lines.en: : Hahah! Me! Pretty! Hahaha! Haha! Adjectives!
lines.zh: : 哈哈！我！漂亮！哈哈哈！哈哈！形容词！

lines.en: : At least you’re not fainting upon receiving compliments anymore.
lines.zh: : 至少你被人夸的时候不会再晕过去了。

lines.en: : It’s...you know, it’s...this isn’t even my dress. You should have seen my mom wearing it. Just not...not like, during the wedding. Because that would mean you’d probably be my dad.
lines.zh: : 这……你知道，这……这甚至不是我的裙子。你真该看看我妈穿它的样子。只是……别是，别是在婚礼上。因为那意味着你大概就是我爸了。

lines.en: : Unless...Unless you were just invited to the...
lines.zh: : 除非……除非你只是被邀请去参加……

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle25
: I’d marry you right now if it wouldn’t send you into a coma.
lines.zh: : 要是不会让你昏过去，我现在就娶你。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle26
: And down she goes.
lines.zh: : 然后她就倒下了。

lines.en: : First you insult me...{i}then{/i} you put my friend into a coma? Are you {i}trying{/i} to incur my wrath today?
lines.zh: : 你先是侮辱我……{i}然后{/i}又把我朋友弄昏过去？你是{i}存心{/i}要今天惹我发怒吗？

lines.en: : What are you even supposed to be? A...sick geisha?
lines.zh: : 你扮的到底是什么？一个……病恹恹的艺伎？

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle27
: Kuchisake-onna obviously! How are you this unfamiliar with Japanese urban legends?! You live in Japan!
lines.zh: : 裂口女，这还用说！你怎么会对日本都市传说陌生到这种地步？！你可是住在日本啊！

lines.en: : Why {i}are{/i} you this familiar with them when you weren’t even allowed to leave your family’s manor until a year ago?
lines.zh: : 你一年前才被允许踏出家门，怎么{i}会{/i}对这些这么熟？

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle28
: I’m okay. Nobody worry about me.
lines.zh: : 我没事。大家别担心我。

lines.en: : You seem to forget how well-read I am, Sensei. And how my interests extend far beyond forks and kyudo down the darkest corridors of Japanese folklore.
lines.zh: : 你好像忘了我是多么博览群书，Sensei。我的兴趣可远不止叉子和弓道，还一路延伸进了日本民俗学最幽暗的走廊。

lines.en: : The tale of Kuchisake-onna dates back to well over a thousand years ago when the wife of a samurai-
lines.zh: : 裂口女的传说可以追溯至一千多年前，那时一位武士的妻子-

lines.en: : Save the history lesson for school. I’m here to {i}party.{/i}
lines.zh: : 历史课留到学校再上。我是来{i}派对{/i}的。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle29
: Then learn to party in a way that doesn’t make me want to slash your face from ear to ear!
lines.zh: : 那就学会用一种不会让我想把你的脸从左耳划到右耳的方式派对！

lines.en: : Well, that doesn’t sound like a very good party at all.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那听起来可不怎么像一场好派对。

lines.en: : What’s your...ideal party even like, Sensei? If you had to organize something like this, how would it go?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你……理想的派对是什么样的？如果要你来办一场这样的活动，你会怎么搞？

lines.en: : You’d be wearing the same thing, but we’d be in a church roughly ten feet in front of the altar.
lines.zh: : 你还穿这身，但我们会站在教堂里，大约就在圣坛前十英尺的地方。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle30
: Two points for me. I’m taking a commanding lead early, Terumi. You’re going to have to work harder if you want to catch up.
lines.zh: : 我得两分。我在开局就取得了压倒性领先，Terumi。你想追上来的话，还得再加把劲。

lines.en: : Would it kill you to not torment the poor girl? She’s clearly inexperienced when it comes to men.
lines.zh: : 你别折磨这个可怜的姑娘，会死吗？她显然对男人毫无经验。

lines.en: : And you aren't?
lines.zh: : 你就有经验了？

lines.en: : Frankly, I feel as though the short time we’ve shared together is more than sufficient in terms of preparing me for any other male I should ever come across.
lines.zh: : 坦白说，我觉得我们共度的那段短暂时光，已经足以让我应付今后遇到的任何男性了。

lines.en: : But even if that were not the case, malevolently tapping into someone’s weakness for your own personal pleasure is not a very kind thing to do and you should be ashamed.
lines.zh: : 即便不是这样，为了自己的快感而去恶意利用别人的弱点，也不是什么善举，你应该感到羞耻。

lines.en: : Tapping into someone’s weakness? You mean like how I call you different names starting with T all the time?
lines.zh: : 利用别人的弱点？你是说就像我总用各种 T 开头的名字叫你那样？

lines.en: : Yes. Though, I’m not sure wanting to be treated with respect is a “weakness.”
lines.zh: : 对。不过，我不确定希望被人尊重算不算一种「弱点」。

lines.en: : Well, it’s not my fault I haven’t figured out any others yet. You’re too perfect and it’s annoying.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我还没找到别的弱点，这可不是我的错。你太完美了，挺烦人的。

lines.en: : That-
scene halloweenfourmingle31
: That was actually very sweet. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 那其实非常贴心。谢谢你。

lines.en: : Hi, it’s me. Karin. I’m back again. And my head hurts now.
lines.zh: : 嗨，是我。Karin。我又回来了。而且我现在头疼。

lines.en: : Please don’t say anything else that will cause her to collapse. You’re going to give the girl a concussion.
lines.zh: : 请别再说任何会让她昏倒的话了。你会把这姑娘弄成脑震荡的。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingle32
: Fine, but only because I don’t want Ayane’s family being somehow held responsible for-
lines.zh: : 好吧，但这只是因为我不想让 Ayane 家莫名其妙地为此承担责任-

lines.en: A sudden tapping on my shoulder pulls me from one conversation where my decisions have led to someone getting hurt-
lines.zh: 一阵突如其来的拍肩，把我从一场对话中拉了出来——在那场对话里，我的决定已经害得有人受了伤-
